description: ResourceContracts is an online repository of publicly available oil, gas and mining contracts, with searchable text and annotated summaries of key terms such as production sharing, fiscal terms, stabilisation and arbitration provisions. It is run by its partners, the Natural Resource Governance Institute, the Columbia Center on Sustainable Investment and the World Bank, to make contract terms easier to understand. On 26 September 2026 the home page listed 3,343 documents from 107 countries covering 82 resources. Access is free through search, country and resource pages, country sites and an API, with contract PDFs and machine-generated text; content is licensed CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats stated by the provider: the summaries are not interpretations, neither the summaries nor the contracts are complete accounts of legal obligations, and the automatically created text may contain errors compared with the original PDFs. For simulation it supplies governance and economic terms of extractive projects, such as royalty rates and obligations for local infrastructure, for policy evaluation and economic models of mining and energy supply. Related catalogue records include EITI open data, which reports the revenues these contracts generate.
